bindings.label: A 50-year-old man presented with subjective fevers, shortness of breath, and worsening cough for 6 days

Patient has medical history of CVID on IVIG every 3 weeks, HIV with undetectable viral load and CD4 count 140 cells/µL on therapy, chronic bronchiectasis with history of Mycobacterium avium complex pulmonary infection, recurrent giardiasis, myopathy on long-term low-dose prednisone, and recurrent herpes simplex virus infections
14 months prior, patient presented with pharyngitis and was on trimethoprim/sulfamethoxazole for Pneumocystis prophylaxis
Physical examination showed oxygen saturation 97% on room air, developed bilateral lower-extremity edema, and ulceration of the glans penis noted during treatment course
Chest CT shows only bronchiectasis without consolidation or ground-glass opacities
CMV viral load increased from 63 to 3171 IU/mL
CMV viral load is rising from 63 to 3171 IU/mL despite antiviral treatment
CMV UL97/UL54 resistance mutations are contributing to the rising viral load despite treatment
Positron emission tomography showed increased uptake in the left adrenal gland with a standardized uptake value of 7.4
